description: This file contains the implementation of the OrderProductDownloadDao interface, providing data access methods for OrderProductDownload entities, specifically methods to retrieve OrderProductDownload records by ID or Order ID, using JPA queries with join fetches.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadDaoImpl
classes.description: Implements data access operations for OrderProductDownload entities, including fetching by ID and Order ID with complex joins.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderProductDownload entity by its ID, with associated joins for related order product and order details.

methods.name: getByOrderId
